description: Baseline CPU instruction counts for all Soroban contract functions. Update by running: bash scripts/benchmark_regression.sh --update-baseline

create_group.notes: Single create_group call with 1 XLM contribution, 1-week cycle, max 5 members. Measured via bench_create_group in gas_benchmark_tests.rs.

join_group.notes: join_group at N=5 members. Derived from bench_join_group_n5 in gas_benchmark_tests.rs.

get_group.notes: Read-only get_group for an existing group. Derived from bench_get_group in gas_benchmark_tests.rs.

is_member.notes: is_member check at N=20 members. Derived from bench_is_member_n20 in gas_benchmark_tests.rs.

get_group_members.notes: get_group_members for a group with 20 members. Derived from bench_get_group_members_n20 in gas_benchmark_tests.rs.

contribute.notes: Optimized contribute() call (13 persistent storage ops after optimization). Based on gas_benchmark.rs storage op model: 13 ops × ~9,123 insns/op = ~118,600.

execute_payout.notes: execute_payout with O(1) reverse-index lookup at N=10 members. Based on gas_benchmark.rs: 15 persistent storage ops × ~5,900 insns/op.

nft-enumerable.description: Non-fungible token contract with enumerable extension (sequential mint, transfer, burn, approve).

mint.notes: Sequential mint via Enumerable::sequential_mint. Writes token owner + updates enumerable index. Measured via bench_mint in nft-enumerable benchmark tests.

transfer.notes: Single-token transfer with enumerable bookkeeping. Updates owner index on both sender and recipient. Measured via bench_transfer.

burn.notes: Burn a single token with enumerable cleanup. Removes entry from owner index and decrements total supply. Measured via bench_burn.

approve.notes: Approve a single-token spend allowance. Writes one approval entry. Measured via bench_approve.

total_supply.notes: Read-only total_supply query from storage. Measured via bench_total_supply.

balance.notes: Read-only balance query for an address. Measured via bench_balance.

get_owner_token_id.notes: Read-only owner-token-ID lookup by index position. Measured via bench_get_owner_token_id.

fungible-allowlist.description: SEP-41 fungible token with AllowList access-control extension.

transfer.notes: AllowList-guarded transfer between two allowed accounts. Checks allowlist status for recipient before transferring. Measured via bench_transfer.

allow_user.notes: Add a user to the allowlist (manager-only). Writes one allowlist entry. Measured via bench_allow_user.

disallow_user.notes: Remove a user from the allowlist (manager-only). Deletes one allowlist entry. Measured via bench_disallow_user.

allowed.notes: Read-only check whether an address is on the allowlist. Measured via bench_allowed.

approve.notes: Approve a spender to transfer tokens on behalf of the caller. Writes one approval entry. Measured via bench_approve.

transfer_from.notes: Allowance-based transfer via approved spender. Reads approval, checks allowlist, transfers, decrements approval. Measured via bench_transfer_from.

balance.notes: Read-only balance query for an address. Measured via bench_balance.
